name: Uzuki Kaguya
source:
Yggdrasil Magical Academy Third Year
Class: Moon Princess

A third-year student a Yggdrasil Girls' Magical Academy, she transferred from the Moon Kingdom to learn magic. 

Having lived a sheltered life until transferring, she's incredibly curious about worldly matters. Her passion lies in developing magic potions, and she's aiming to earn her formal qualifications at the academy. Aphrodisiacs are her specialty, but she sometimes makes mistakes while experimenting with them on herself. Perhaps because of this, she can become overstimulated, and it takes a lot more than some caresses to get her going.

She tries to act like a strong, dependable sister in front of the [url=/c64356]protagonist[/url], but she sometimes also reveals her cuter side, getting sulky when he doesn't give her enough attention.
